title: AIPadhaiApp golden-answer seed (multi-board, v1)
description: Smoke-level golden dataset covering CBSE (Class 6-12), ICSE, IGCSE, Maharashtra/Karnataka/TamilNadu/AP-Telangana/UP State Boards, JEE Main/Advanced, NEET UG, UPSC GS, SSC GK.
